## Alignment
| default | left | center | right |
|---------|:--------|:-------:|--------:|
| a | b | c | d |
| e | f | g | h |

## Escaped cells
| input | note |
|---------|---------|
| a\|b | a pipe would split the cell |
| line<br>break | a newline would end the row |

## Escaped by hand
a\|b

|  NAME  | VALUE  |

| CUSTOM | TABLE  |

|  name   |                       value                       |
|---------|---------------------------------------------------|
| wrapped | a longer value that may be wrapped by tablewriter |
